Generate meta tags

The first step in making a website SEO-ready is adding meta tags. For best results, include a combination of standard HTML and Open Graph tags.

To emphasize the point, here's a quote:

For best results, include a combination

Explain how to do it with a code snippet:

<main {...storyblokEditable(blok)}>
	{
		blok.body?.map((blok) => {
			return <StoryblokComponent blok={blok} />;
		})
	}
	<Fragment set:html={renderedRichText} />
	
</main>
